name: rpi-subagents
description: Delegation extension: single `subagent` tool that spawns focused child rpi sessions with per-agent prompts, tool allowlists and depth limits; composite tasks/steps runs (ADR-0018), background async runs (ADR-0019), model fallback chains.
author: revpidev
descriptionZh: 子代理委派:单个 `subagent` 工具派生专注的子 rpi 会话,支持 per-agent 提示词、工具白名单与深度限制;组合 tasks/steps 运行、后台异步运行、模型回退链。
